summary: A staffed light on Sarah Island at the entrance to Tolmie Channel, begun in 1907 as an unwatched gas beacon and rebuilt twice.

notes_for_editor: Thin sourcing: no keeper registers for Canada in corpus, no Marine reports after 1915 hit. Keeper roster is Lighthouse Friends' list only (Wikipedia adds Angus Macdonald 1965 and Dwyer to 1998; not used). Wikipedia infobox says station established 1897; all other sources say 1907. 1907 date rests on the heritage statement and the 1908-printed report listing a gas beacon; the report's fiscal year was not confirmed. Maid of Orleans account is LighthouseFriends citing the Vancouver Sun, not read directly. Characteristic Oc W 5s taken from the station record, not re-verified. Footnotes 2 and 4 are the same report (pp. 54 and 60), matched by corpus.py page. Fact-check: 1908-printed report covers only the nine months ended 31 March 1907 (its text says so); its gas-beacon list is undated, so 1907 rests mainly on the heritage statement and Lighthouse Friends.
